vol.name: Star Wars: The Mandalorian & Grogu – Nightmare on Nevarro

title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian & Grogu – Nightmare on Nevarro #1
desc:
Sinister creatures with glowing red eyes are terrorizing the people of Nevarro, and it’s up to the Mandalorian Din Djarin and his foundling Grogu to put an end to the haunting! Once again, the pair venture into the belly of Nevarro’s magma-filled lava tubes to uncover the truth.

Between menacing cave creatures, a deranged mining droid, and the red-eyed flying specters, surviving the darkness may be the greatest challenge of all.

It’s a spooky Star Wars adventure where not everything is as it seems!
